hero.heading: Canadian and African Women Aid Program
hero.intro: CAWAP is a Brampton non-profit supporting racialized Canadian and African women and their families through education, empowerment and direct community services.

about.heading: Fighting hunger, racism and isolation — together
about.body:
CAWAP works every day against systemic racism, hunger and isolation. Through food access, youth and senior programs, newcomer support, skills training and financial literacy, the organisation helps families not only survive but thrive.

The Sankofa Royale Awards are CAWAP's signature celebration: a night to honour the community it serves and to raise the funds that keep its programs running all year long.
